26 likes, 3 comments - assetyogi on September 23, 2026: "Taking a personal loan might seem like the easiest fix during an emergency, but it often comes with 15–24% interest rates and strict credit score requirements. Before you apply for a costly personal loan, consider these 5 smart, low-cost alternatives that let you borrow against your own assets at a fraction of the cost.

1. Loan Against FD: Borrow up to 90–95% of your FD value at just 1–2% above your FD interest rate. No credit check required, and your original FD keeps earning interest.

2. Gold Loan: Quick approval with lower CIBIL requirements. Interest rates typically range between 9–12%.

3. Loan Against Mutual Funds: Get instant liquidity without redeeming your investments. Your market compounding stays intact while you access cash.

4. Loan Against Life Insurance: Traditional endowment or money-back policies allow you to borrow against their surrender value at reasonable rates (10–12.5%).

5. PPF Loan or EPFO Advance: PPF Loan available from the 3rd to 6th financial year at just 1% interest above the PPF return rate. EPFO Advance: Withdraw an interest-free, non-refundable advance for medical, housing, or emergency needs.

[Personal Loan, Personal Loan Alternatives, Personal Finance]

#assetyogi #finance #loan".

P2P Payments (Friends & Family)

100% FREE! No matter how much money you transfer to your friends, family, or self-accounts, there are zero charges.

Daily Shopping

20 likes, 0 comments - assetyogi on September 10, 2026: "Most people don't know this hidden condition for PF withdrawals: the viral claim that "if your PF balance is over ₹50,000, 20% TDS will be deducted" is not entirely true.

TDS applies only when all three of these conditions are met simultaneously:

 Withdrawal amount: Exceeds ₹50,000
 Service period: Less than 5 years of total continuous service
 Documentation: PAN or Form 15G/15H has not been submitted

If you have completed 5 years of service, your withdrawal is 100% tax-free and TDS-free, regardless of the amount. Understanding these rules is essential to prevent unnecessary TDS deductions. Save this before withdrawing your EPF!

(PF withdrawal TDS rules, EPF)

#assetyogi #pf #tds".

39 likes, 0 comments - assetyogi on September 9, 2026: "The 1-Year Gratuity Myth is Costing You Big Time 😳

Most employees don't know this hidden rule in Indian labor laws — if you are a full-time, permanent employee, the new 1-year gratuity rule DOES NOT apply to you. You still need 5 continuous years of service with your employer to claim gratuity. That 1-year rule is strictly meant for fixed-term and contractual employees with a written contract. Assuming you qualify for gratuity after just 12 months without checking your contract type can leave you empty-handed when you switch jobs. Understanding how gratuity eligibility works, who qualifies under the new rules, and how it impacts your final settlement can save you lakhs. Save this before you quit your job!

(Gratuity, Labor Laws, Gratuity Rules)

#assetyogi #gratuity #employeewellbeing".

64 likes, 1 comments - assetyogi on September 8, 2026: "The Hidden Loan Settlement Trap 😳

Most people don't know this hidden risk in loan settlement — if you miss an EMI after signing your bank settlement agreement, the bank can cancel your one time settlement (OTS) and revive your original loan liability with full interest and penalties. What started as a ₹2.1 lakh pending balance can jump to ₹7+ lakh overnight. Before you go for loan settlement in India, always read the default clause carefully, and if you miss an EMI, immediately inform the bank in writing. Understanding the loan settlement process, how OTS works, and its impact on your CIBIL score can save you lakhs. Save this before you regret it later.

(loan settlement, loan settlement India, default clause loan agreement, bank loan settlement process, EMI, CIBIL score, loan settlement letter, personal loan settlement, bank recovery agent)

#loan #assetyogi #personalfinance".
